judgeIssues.detail: The shipped translation for this exact string is "Unwrapped" (unwrap/wrapped are do-not-translate terms kept verbatim, and sibling shipped strings keep wrap-family labels in English). "Unwrap berhasil" diverges from the established rendering for the same source label.

evidence.rule: glossary: "unwrap"/"wrapped" — DO NOT TRANSLATE (keep verbatim); shipped: Unwrapped → Unwrapped

judgeIssues.detail: Source is the bare status label "Unwrapped"; the translation adds "berhasil" (successful), introducing content not in the source. Sibling status labels (Wrapping, Wrapped, Unwrapping) are all bare labels.
